name: SocialCrew Widgets
author: Social Crew

sections.description:
Bring the excitement of football to your WordPress site with SocialCrew Widgets. Forget complex script configurations; with our plugin, you can add professional results widgets, league tables, and interactive polls in seconds.

Whether you are a sports blogger, a news portal owner, or a fan community manager, SocialCrew Widgets provides the perfect toolset to keep your audience engaged and informed.

Why choose SocialCrew Widgets?

  • Instant Installation: Add widgets via Gutenberg Blocks or simple Shortcodes.
  • Real-Time Data: Always up-to-date football scores, match schedules, and league standings.
  • Adaptive Design: Widgets adjust perfectly to any theme and screen size (fully mobile-friendly).
  • Preset Management: Configure your widgets once in the admin dashboard and use them anywhere on your site.
  • Performance Optimized: Smart loading ensures your site remains fast and responsive.

What can you display?

  • Live scores and match results.
  • League standings for domestic and international competitions.
  • Match schedules (fixtures) by team or league.
  • Interactive polls to engage your fans.

External services

This plugin relies on SocialCrew’s hosted widget loader to render content in the visitor’s browser.

  • What the service is: The endpoint https://widgets-api.socialcrew.io/load serves the JavaScript module that powers the widget UI (tables, results, polls, etc.).
  • Data sent: On each page view where a widget is embedded, the visitor’s browser requests this URL. Only public widget parameters (such as widget ID and display settings) are sent. The plugin does not send WordPress user credentials or private admin data.
  • Documentation: SocialCrew Widgets
  • Terms of Use: https://widgets.socialcrew.io/termos-de-uso
  • Privacy Policy: https://widgets.socialcrew.io/politica-de-privacidade

Privacy

Privacy is important to us. When a visitor loads a page with a widget, the browser requests the necessary script from SocialCrew. No personal data from the WordPress user is shared. For more details, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New and search for “SocialCrew Widgets” or upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to Settings → SocialCrew Widgets to create your first widgets or manage your favorites.
  4. Use the SocialCrew Widget block in the page editor or insert the shortcode [socialcrew_widget_saved id="..."].
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the WordPress plugin is free and simplifies the integration of widgets from the SocialCrew platform.

Do I need coding skills?

Not at all! The plugin is designed for everyone, using the intuitive Gutenberg block editor or simple shortcodes.

Do widgets work on mobile devices?

Yes! All widgets are “adaptive,” meaning they automatically adjust to the user’s screen size.

Where are saved widgets stored?

They are securely stored in your WordPress database and can be easily managed through the admin panel.

Can I use a custom loader URL?

Not in this version; the loader URL is fixed to the SocialCrew production endpoint.
